dictionary.install_linux_step_1: Open Terminal on the Linux computer.
dictionary.install_linux_step_2: Paste the command and press Enter.
dictionary.install_linux_step_3: Return here and approve the connection request.
dictionary.install_windows_step_1: Press the button below: Nuxiva_Setup.exe and the pairing file are downloaded.
dictionary.install_windows_step_2: Open Nuxiva_Setup.exe from your Downloads folder: it installs and pairs the PC by itself.
dictionary.install_macos_step_1: Download the Mac package when available.
dictionary.install_macos_step_2: Open the package and authorize launch.
dictionary.install_macos_step_3: Wait for enrollment and check the status in Nodes and Servers.
dictionary.install_esp32_step_1: Connect the board by USB to the Nuxiva server.
dictionary.install_esp32_step_2: Detect USB ports on the Nuxiva server.
dictionary.install_esp32_step_3: Once flashing is available, enter the Wi-Fi details and confirm the firmware write.
dictionary.install_linux_guide: Open Terminal on the Linux computer. Paste the command below, press Enter and approve the connection request on this page. You need Python 3, curl and an account with sudo access.
dictionary.install_windows_guide: No setup and no ZIP: you only need the Windows PC to connect. If the browser asks to allow multiple downloads, accept.
dictionary.install_macos_guide: The macOS package is in preparation. Guided enrollment still requires a verified installer compatible with Mac.
dictionary.install_esp32_guide: USB detection is available. Automatic firmware flashing is in preparation.
dictionary.install_esp32_no_ports: No USB ports detected. Connect the board with a data cable and try again.
dictionary.windows_download_hint: Keep both files in the same folder. The pairing file holds a one-time code: keep it private and use it before it expires.
dictionary.windows_download_failed: Download failed. Check that HTTPS is enabled and try again.

dictionary.pc_link_hint: You do not need to install the full Nuxiva server on the second PC; Linux and Python 3 are enough. Copy and run this command on that PC to install the small Nuxiva agent, then approve its request on this page. If the server uses a local HTTPS certificate, install the Nuxiva CA on the PC first.
dictionary.pc_code_hint: Alternatively generate a code and use --code CODE instead of --join. Codes expire after ten minutes.
dictionary.res_hint_calm: The machine has headroom: everything stays active and only screens covered by others stop drawing.
dictionary.res_hint_elevated: Idle things are unloaded sooner and caches over budget are cleaned.
dictionary.res_hint_high: Saving mode: unused models and screens are unloaded to stay responsive.
dictionary.res_hint_critical: Maximum saving: voice, security and rescue stay guaranteed, everything else is freed.
dictionary.windows_installer_unavailable: The latest version cannot be read: check the server’s Internet connection.
